location.en: Maple Bay Central Bus Station, ticket office

goal.en: Top up your bus card and find the right bus to school.
goal.zh: 幫公車卡儲值，並問清楚哪班公車到學校。

background: bus station ticket office with a glass service window, a card reader on the counter, rows of metal benches, tiled floor, large windows showing parked blue city buses, morning light

intro.en: School starts next week. Mia gave you her old bus card, but it's almost empty.
intro.zh: 下週就要開學了。米亞把她的舊公車卡送給你，但裡面幾乎沒錢了。

intro.en: At the ticket office, an agent in thick glasses looks up from his screen.
intro.zh: 售票處裡，一位戴著粗框眼鏡的站務員從螢幕前抬起頭。

lines.en: Morning. Next, please. How can I help you?
lines.zh: 早安，下一位。有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

choices.en: I'd like to top up this card.
choices.tip: top up 就是「儲值、加值」，I'd like to... 是禮貌說出需求的句型。

choices.en: Hi. I want to save money in it.

lines.en: Save money? This is a bus station, not a bank.
lines.zh: 存錢？這裡是公車站，不是銀行。

story.en: The agent kindly gives you directions to the nearest bank. You walk there and back, and your card is still empty.
story.zh: 站務員好心告訴你最近的銀行怎麼走。你走過去又走回來，卡片還是空的。

fail.why: 「儲值」不能直譯成 save money，save money 是「存錢、省錢」。幫交通卡加值要說 top up：I'd like to top up this card.。

choices.en: I'm fine, thank you. And you?

lines.en: ...I'm good. So, what do you need today?
lines.zh: ……我很好。所以，你今天要辦什麼？

story.en: The people behind you start sighing. You panic, forget why you came and leave with a free bus map.
story.zh: 後面排隊的人開始嘆氣。你一緊張，忘了自己來做什麼，最後只拿了一張免費的公車路線圖離開。

fail.why: How can I help you? 是「需要什麼幫忙？」，不是 How are you?。直接說出需求：I'd like to top up this card.。

lines.en: Sure. Do you ride the bus every day? A monthly pass might be cheaper.
lines.zh: 好的。你每天都搭公車嗎？辦月票可能比較划算。

choices.en: Yes. How much is a monthly pass?
choices.tip: How much is...? 是問價錢最簡單的句型；monthly pass 就是「月票」。

choices.en: Yes, I am. How much is it?

lines.en: You are...? Oh, a student? Then I'll need your student ID.
lines.zh: 你是……？喔，學生嗎？那我需要看你的學生證。

story.en: You don't have a student ID yet. You'll have to come back next week, and you pay cash for every ride until then.
story.zh: 你還沒拿到學生證，只好下週再來。在那之前，每趟車都得付現金。

fail.why: 用 Do you...? 問的問題，要用 do 回答：Yes, I do.。回答 Yes, I am.，對方會以為你在回答「你是不是……」的問題。

choices.en: Then why didn't you tell me first?

lines.zh: 呃……我現在不就在跟你說了。

story.en: After that, the agent does everything by the book. Slowly. Very slowly. Your bus leaves without you.
story.zh: 接下來站務員一切照規矩來，慢慢地，非常慢地。你要搭的公車就這樣開走了。

fail.why: Why didn't you tell me...? 聽起來像在責怪對方。對方好心給建議時，先道謝再問細節：Oh, thanks! How much is a monthly pass?。

lines.en: There you go. Sixty dollars, unlimited rides for a month. Anything else?
lines.zh: 好了。六十元，一個月無限搭乘。還有其他需要嗎？

choices.en: Does bus 12 go to the language school?
choices.zh: 12 號公車有到語言學校嗎？
choices.tip: Does this bus go to...? 是確認路線的必備句，上車前問一句最安心。

choices.en: Bus 12 is go to the language school?

lines.en: Bus 12 is...? Sorry, I didn't catch the question.
lines.zh: 12 號公車是……？抱歉，我沒聽懂你的問題。

story.en: You give up and guess. Bus 21 looks close enough, right? You get a free, very long tour of the industrial district.
story.zh: 你放棄追問，憑感覺上車。21 號看起來差不多吧？結果你免費參觀了一趟好長的工業區之旅。

fail.why: is 和 go 不能直接放在一起。問公車路線要用 Does + 主詞 + go to...?：Does bus 12 go to the language school?。

choices.en: Can bus 12 arrive the language school?
choices.zh: 12 號公車可以到達語言學校嗎？

lines.en: Arrive...? Do you want the full timetable?
lines.zh: 到達……？你要完整的時刻表嗎？

story.en: The agent prints the timetable for all forty routes. You study it on a bench for an hour and still don't know which bus to take.
story.zh: 站務員印給你四十條路線的完整時刻表。你坐在長椅上研究了一個小時，還是不知道該搭哪一班。

fail.why: arrive 後面要接 at 或 in，而且問公車有沒有到某地，英文習慣用 go to：Does bus 12 go to the language school?。

lines.en: Yes, it stops right in front of it. Have a great first day!
lines.zh: 有，就停在學校正門口。開學第一天加油！

lines.en: Later, on bus 12, you tap your new pass. Beep! Maple Bay suddenly feels a lot smaller.
lines.zh: 後來搭上 12 號公車，你把月票往感應器一靠，「嗶」！楓灣好像一下子變小了。

story.en: With a monthly pass in your pocket, the whole city is now just a bus ride away.
story.zh: 口袋裡有了月票，整座城市都只是一趟公車的距離。

notes.explain: 幫交通卡、預付卡加值都用 top up，可以再加上金額，例如 top up twenty dollars。

example.en: I'd like to top up my card with twenty dollars.
example.zh: 我想幫卡片儲值二十元。

notes.explain: 一個月內不限次數搭乘的票，也有 weekly pass（週票）。每天通勤的話，通常比儲值划算。

example.en: A monthly pass is cheaper if you ride every day.
example.zh: 如果每天搭車，月票比較划算。

notes.explain: 上車前確認路線最好用的句型，也可以直接問司機。注意是 Does... go，不是 Is... go。

example.en: Excuse me, does this bus go to the train station?
example.zh: 請問這班公車有到火車站嗎？

notes.explain: save money 是「省錢」或「存錢」。幫卡片儲值要說 top up，說 save money 會讓人以為你要去銀行。

example.en: A monthly pass will save you money.

notes.en: Yes, I do. / Yes, I am.
notes.zh: 用 do 問，就用 do 答
notes.explain: Do you...? 要用 Yes, I do. 回答；Are you...? 才用 Yes, I am.。回答的助動詞要和問句對應。

example.en: Do you take the bus? Yes, I do.
example.zh: 你搭公車嗎？是的，我有搭。
